# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Theology student and minister at Tanner Street Mission Church  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend Ez  <sub>[v1 c19 P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012)</sub>; Ezra  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>; Ezra Hale  <sub>[v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is described as a lanky, exceptionally plain or unattractive young man with very long legs and stooped shoulders. He has flaxen, limp, unkempt hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and noticeably large ears. Despite his plain looks, he has a scholarly forehead, impassioned dark eyes when serious, and an attractive, beautiful voice.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c24 P11](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0011), [v1 c24 P15](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0015), [v1 c25 P10](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0010)_

## Personality

Ezra possesses a deeply serious, gentle, sincere, and faithful nature, showing a great earnestness toward his life's calling. He has a cheerful and friendly disposition, frequently laughing, telling jokes, and getting along well with older women as well as young people. Though he can be timid or hesitant in expressing his feelings, he holds a quiet determination to perform his duty. He also possesses a strong sense of humor and does not mind being teased.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P22](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0022), [v1 c24 P12](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0012), [v1 c24 P15](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0015), [v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021)_

- Fulfill his calling as a minister and serve the needy  <sub>[v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009)</sub>
- Marry Cressida Lindsay  <sub>[v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020)</sub>

## History

Ezra studied theology at St. Columbia after graduating from Wexcombe College. During a summer break, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church and boarded at Mrs. Emily's select boardinghouse, where he met Cressida Lindsay and became close friends with her. Although initially hesitant to express his romantic feelings because of his lack of wealth, he was deeply in love with Cressida. After completing his theological studies at St. Columbia, he was assigned to take charge of a small mission church on Tanner Street in the slums. He eventually proposed to Cressida Lindsay, and the two were married at her family home, Mount Holly, in June.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P9](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0009), [v1 c25 P8](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0008), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v1 c29 P40](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0040)_
